name: Genesis Glass · 琉璃
description: Genesis 结构 × macOS 原生玻璃。外壳(ribbon/标签栏/侧栏)溶进窗后景深,主视图纸卡保持全实色 —— 正文永远不透背景。不定义任何颜色,任意配色/明暗都成立。
descriptionEn: Native macOS glass around a fully opaque reading surface. Follows your accent and background palette.
author: Forsion

settings.label: 外壳浓度
settings.description: ribbon 与主区外框。越小越透，壁纸看得越清
settings.descriptionEn: Ribbon and main frame. Lower values show more wallpaper.

settings.label: 侧栏浓度
settings.description: 侧栏文字密度高，通常要比外壳厚一档才压得住
settings.descriptionEn: Keep the sidebar more opaque than the shell for legibility.

settings.label: 浮层浓度
settings.description: 大型弹窗的基准浓度；菜单自动薄一档，侧栏浮层自动厚一档
settings.descriptionEn: Base level for dialogs; menus are lighter and sidebar overlays are stronger.

settings.label: 局部模糊
settings.description: 影响输入卡、菜单和弹窗；外壳模糊仍由窗口原生材质提供
settings.descriptionEn: Affects the composer, menus and dialogs. The shell uses native blur.

settings.label: 透色鲜艳度
settings.description: 不提饱和度，透过来的东西就是一层脏灰
settings.descriptionEn: Sets how vivid the content behind glass appears.

settings.label: 浮层描边
settings.description: 浮层压在壁纸上时，边缘靠这根发丝线交代
settings.descriptionEn: A fine edge helps overlays stand out against wallpaper.

preview.tagline: 原生玻璃 · 纸面可读
